plugins.name: Sing-box core
plugins.description: Universal proxy platform by SagerNet. Supports VMess, VLESS, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria and more. Recommended for most setups.

plugins.name: Xray core
plugins.description: XTLS/Xray-core. Best-in-class for VLESS/XTLS and Reality. Use when your server uses XTLS-Reality or VLESS.

plugins.name: Clash (mihomo) core
plugins.description: MetaCubeX/mihomo (Clash Meta). Rich rule-based routing and subscription support. Best for multi-server configs.

plugins.name: Tor core
plugins.description: The Tor Project. Anonymous communication over the Tor network. Distributed inside the Orbot APK — install Orbot from F-Droid/Play Store, then this entry launches the bundled tor binary. Alternatively, extract tor from the Orbot APK manually.

plugins.name: DNSCrypt proxy
plugins.description: DNSCrypt/dnscrypt-proxy. Flexible DNS proxy with support for encrypted DNS protocols (DNSCrypt, DoH, DoT) and ad-blocking via filter lists.

plugins.name: ByeDPI
plugins.description: hufrea/byedpi. Local DPI bypass proxy. Splits and manipulates packets to evade deep packet inspection. Lightweight, no server needed.

plugins.name: I2P (i2pd)
plugins.description: PurpleI2P/i2pd. End-to-end encrypted anonymous network layer. Provides I2P connectivity for .i2p sites and services.

plugins.name: Cloudflare WARP (wgcf)
plugins.description: ViRb3/wgcf — unofficial CLI for Cloudflare WARP. Generates WireGuard config from your WARP account. The config is then run by the sing-box/WireGuard core. NOTE: wgcf has no android-arm64 build; this downloads the linux-arm64 binary which runs on Android via the app's exec environment, or use it to generate a config on a PC and import.
